title: Scott B NDE 22991
content: While dead, I was in the presence of the Supreme Being. There was no pain. Although I was aware of my accident, I had no speech. It was more of a thought transfer or telepathy. There was no darkness, only light. There was had no sense of time; I felt like I was out for 10 minutes. When I woke from the coma, I was told I was out for 5 days! I was in a different consciousness that was a more aware, higher state of being. I did not want to come back, even though I knew I had loved ones on earth including a child. Where I was, was so wonderful that it trumped all experiences on earth. In particular, there was the feeling of being loved without worry or sadness. I've been in and out of prisons and jail was my whole life since my youth. These punishments did nothing for my addictions but perhaps made them worse. I had a little time of being sober by going to meetings but the underlying urge was still there. I ultimately would wind up at the crack house again. This experience has taken the urge from me. Our time here is so short and I feel like I was sent back to tell others the TRUTH. We do not simply go into a grave after the body dies and that's all. Rather, that is a beginning to really living.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident. I was a practicing crack addict, drinker, and pot smoker, at the time of the accident. I’d been doing these substances for years and never had anything even remotely close to this experience. I was clinically dead from going over 80 mph on a Kawasaki Ninja with no helmet on when I crashed and died.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: It was as if I was awoken from a sleep and now in the Real state of being.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Higher state of consciousness, more aware. As if I was awoken from a sleep and now in the Real state of being.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There is no essence of time there. Felt like I was out for 10 min and found out I was out for 5 days.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Sight was intense; no sound, mental state was intense, no physical feeling like touch. Not sure of smell.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Light was everywhere, not like the Sun gives us but rather everywhere. It was like I was in the light. There was no darkness at all. I was IN the light. The light was everywhere. Not like the Sun gives us light from a source but rather I was in the source.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I remember pleading with the light, or presence, that was felt to let me stay. There was nothing but me and this presence.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I was IN the light. The light was everywhere. Not like the Sun gives us light from a source but rather I was in the source.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Sight was intense, no sound, mental state was intense, no physical feeling like touch.Not sure of smell.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Upset I was sent back! I was loved with a Love we cannot comprehend. No fear, worry, doubt. LOVE, JOY, PEACE, Ah-h-h-h-h-h, I'm finally home where I truly belong. Sobbing with joy and pouring out with emotion.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe There is MORE. I came to know that.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will YES and I didn't agree. I was aware of there being a decision made and I guess it was not my time, although I remember pleading to stay specifically.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will YES and I didn't agree. I was aware of there being a decision made and I guess it was not my time, although I remember pleading to stay specifically. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now know this is temporary and life here is very short in the grand scheme of things. Not scared of death now, don't go looking for it either. Not my decision.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes There was no speech, only telepathy. Nothing on this physical earth can compare except perhaps the feeling you experienced if you were there for the birth of your child x 100. It was really wonderful!
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best was knowing there's more and how wonderful it is. Worst was being sent back to Earth.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I've run into several people who have had the same experience in some ways, if not all. We all agree that there is no essence of time and no pain as well as we all wanted to stay. In modern terms, it's all good; everything was wonderful beyond words. They also experienced telepathy, no speech.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: The best part was knowing that there's more and how wonderful it is. The worst part was being sent back to Earth. I'd love to share my experience with others as I feel that was one of the main reasons I was sent back.
